name: Stellar Syndicates — galaxy-map optical lens-flare stars
usage: Separate candidate sprites for the galaxy map. The detailed stars-2026-09-08 set is preserved for system-view use. No live renderer, runtime assets, size curves or hit areas changed.

generation.actual_model: Not exposed by the built-in tool

stars.title: Red Dwarf
stars.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent raster star sprite for the dark GALAXY MAP of the premium space strategy game Stellar Syndicates.
Primary request: a distant star seen through an optical lens, with a beautiful bright lens-flare / diffraction-spike effect, NOT a close-up textured solar globe.
Style: clean high-end astronomical optical rendering. Crisp luminous core, elegant tapered diffraction rays, delicate soft colored glow. Must read clearly at only 32–72 pixels on a dark navy map. No brush strokes or noisy cloud texture.
Composition: square canvas, one isolated centered stellar object. Center of light exactly at canvas center. Four dominant slender optical rays (up/down/left/right), subtler short diagonal rays, their tips no closer than 10% to the image edges. Rays are thin, not fat geometric diamond blades. Core is small and brilliantly white-hot; a compact colored halo identifies the star type. Rays and glow fall off smoothly into actual transparent pixels.
Background: genuinely transparent PNG RGBA. No black square, no background starfield, no opaque haze; preserve graded alpha on glow.
Avoid: text, labels, watermark, selection circles, UI badges, orbit diagrams, ships, planets, landscape, off-center lens-ghost dots, large resolved solar disk, opaque background.

Subject-specific design (takes priority over the shared ray geometry where noted): A red dwarf: a tiny warm-white central glint, rich ruby-red and ember-orange optical flare, tightly contained reddish glow. Quiet, jewel-like and modest, no angry explosion or red solar disk. Keep a definite white-hot center and four fine red diffraction spikes.
